blocks.text: Kisi compound ki lattice energy ek seedhe tajurbe se tai nahi ho sakti, magar kai tajurbati data se Born-Haber cycle naami energy cycle se nikali ja sakti hai, jo Hess ke qanoon ka istemal hai. Sodium chloride ke liye anasir Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) seedhe solid NaCl banate hain (delta Hf, standard enthalpy of formation, calorimeter mein asani se napi jati hai) ya gaseous ions Na+(g) + Cl-(g) se guzarte hain: delta Hx sodium aur chlorine ko un ki standard states se gaseous ions mein badalne ki kul energy hai, aur gaseous ions phir solid banate hain (delta Hlatt). Hess ke qanoon se delta Hx + delta Hlatt = delta Hf. Delta Hx ke marahil dikhane ke liye phailaya hua energy tikon mukammal Born-Haber cycle hai.

blocks.alt: Enthalpy ki seerhi: sodium metal aur chlorine gas se sabz teer sodium ki atomization (+108), chlorine ki atomization (+121) aur sodium ki ionization (+496) se sodium ions, electrons aur chlorine atoms tak charhte hain; surkh teer electron affinity (-349) se gaseous ions tak girta hai, aur lamba surkh teer lattice energy se solid NaCl tak girta hai; enthalpy of formation (-411) ka neela teer shuru ko aakhir se jorta hai. Daen dabbe jama-tafreeq karte aur har term ki tareef dete hain.
blocks.caption: Chhapi hui qeematon ke saath sodium chloride ka Born-Haber cycle (Figures 6.8 aur 6.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; paimane par nahi).
blocks.long_description: Anasir se shuru kar ke sodium atomize aur ionize hota hai aur chlorine atomize, sab endothermic, phir chlorine atoms electrons lete hain, exothermic; yeh chaar qadam delta Hx = +376 kJ fi mol tak jama hote hain. Seedha rasta enthalpy of formation hai, -411. Kyunke dono raste solid NaCl par milte hain, lattice energy -411 - 376 = -787 kJ fi mol hai, woh qeemat jo koi ek tajurba nahi de sakta.

blocks.text: Sample Problem 6.9: sodium fluoride, jo sodium chloride lattice mein crystallize hota hai, ki heat of formation us ke cycle se. Na(s) ki heat of atomization 109, F2 ki aadhi bond energy 79, sodium ki ionization energy 494, fluorine ki electron affinity -328 aur lattice energy -939 kJ fi mol hai: delta Hf = -939 + 109 + 494 + 79 - 328 = -585 kJ fi mol.

blocks.prompt: Lithium fluoride ki heat of formation nikalein: Li(s) ki atomization 161, F2 ki aadhi bond energy 79, lithium ki ionization 520, fluorine ki electron affinity -328, lattice energy -1107 kJ fi mol (print mein nishan ke baghair).
blocks.explanation: Delta Hf = delta Hlatt + delta Hat(Li) + IE(Li) + delta Hat(F) + EA(F) = -1107 + 161 + 520 + 79 - 328 = -675 kJ fi mol.

items: Born-Haber cycle: ionic solid par Hess ka qanoon; delta Hx (atomizations + ionization + electron affinity) + delta Hlatt = delta Hf. NaCl: 108 + 496 + 121 - 349 = +376; lattice energy = -411 - 376 = -787 kJ fi mol. NaF formation: -939 + 109 + 494 + 79 - 328 = -585 kJ fi mol.
